steps.what: Act as advisers to student organizations through discussion and contextual guidance

tasks.design: Retain dialogue and contextual advice with the lecturer. Policies in {DOCS} support the discussion without replacing the advisory relationship.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student goals and organisational circumstances vary.
tasks.enabler_now: A generic answer tool does not establish equivalent contextual advice.
tasks.still_hard: Help students decide while respecting their ownership of the organisation.
tasks.altitude: Advisory time and responsibilities remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Contextual student advice requires dialogue and judgement; no clerical saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is direct advice, excluding event administration and separately prepared materials.
Students express goals and questions during the discussion and the lecturer clarifies them in s1; no structured need or eligibility flag is assumed.
Existing policy access suffices; no custom tool is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new process or system is introduced.
unknowns: Adviser remit and student organisation needs
research_questions: Which questions need referral beyond the lecturer's remit?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; the advisory dialogue remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define research contribution, methods, resources and fit to the funding call
Write grant proposal sections from the verified research brief

loop.input: verified research brief, call requirements and supplied references
loop.output: proposal sections with source and requirement links
loop.check: Lecturer checks fidelity to original contribution, method feasibility, claims, citations and commitments against brief
loop.stop: One revision then manual composition for unsupported or misleading sections
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative argument and call-specific wording exceed fixed template fields

steps.what: Verify the final proposal and accept its exact internal version

tasks.design: Use the existing {DOCS} application template and a bounded draft from the lecturer's research brief. Retain intellectual design, reference checking and acceptance before separate institutional authorisation and submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Application prose must reconcile a new idea with call-specific requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-bound draft can organise supplied content while leaving intellectual choices with the researcher.
tasks.still_hard: Original contribution, method credibility, budget commitments and accurate citations.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what research is worth doing and defend its feasibility.
tasks.altitude: Some less first-pass application prose; research and submission authority stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Call requirements, budgets and institutional commitments

evidence.claim: EduGenAI offers a university chat-platform pilot; it does not establish grant quality or grant-writing savings.
The bounded proposal design and savings are unmeasured model-knowledge assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is the lecturer's own application preparation, excluding peer review, institutional authorisation and external submission.

The lecturer captures research question, original contribution, methods, source references, work plan, resource estimates, call version and section limits in s1; full reading and capture time stays. Missing references or commitments require manual clarification, never generated facts.

Research support supplies confirmed cost and institutional commitment information before it enters the brief; additional clarification and maintenance is counted as other-role work. Unconfirmed items remain explicit gaps.
Test native application templates before custom tooling. Only institution-permitted material enters a permitted draft tool; restricted content is written manually.
unknowns: Existing templates and actual prose correction effort
research_questions: Does source-bound drafting reduce total preparation after citation and commitment checks?

already_counted.description: Research brief capture and final scholarly acceptance

approvals.approved_version: Exact call version, proposal text, references, costs and commitments; any edit voids acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R89.5 gross10.5 minus6 upkeep gives net4.5. Range0-1 allows infrequent calls, original argument rewriting and citation verification to consume most drafting gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A small reduction in application prose where permitted verified material exists.
reach: Work with research support on explicit commitments and call requirements
skills_to_grow: Separating research design from application wording
role.ambitious_version: A lecturer with more explicit grant evidence while retaining responsibility for the research.
